Gang Orca.name: Gang Orca
Gang Orca.basicInfo:
Kugo Sakamata, the pro hero Gang Orca, a longtime top-ten hero: an orca heteromorph often taken for a villain, and one of the field's most rigorous professionals. Huge and powerful, a black orca head with white eye patches, red eyes, a toothed snout and a dorsal fin; a white suit, fuchsia shirt and black tie.
Speaking Style: Deep, formal and measured; names a mistake plainly and expects it fixed.
Combat Role: Heavy hitter and controller: orca strength and paralyzing ultrasonic waves; heat and dry air wear him down.
Under Pressure: Takes command with imposing calm and directs his sidekicks precisely.
Gang Orca.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Strangers take him for a villain, yet few heroes are more conscientious; he will even play the villain to train young heroes. Motivation: See that heroes are ready for real danger before they meet it. Connections: His armored sidekicks, who carry quick-setting cement guns and water for him. The Hero Public Safety Commission, which values his judgment of hero candidates. Crust, a high-ranking pro on the same waterfront. Knowledge: The Commission's standards, and a suspicion that something comes off the night ships unseen by customs. Canon voice & behavior: Stands motionless and lets his presence work; gives a hard, fair verdict once. Thread: What moves through the container docks after midnight.
QUIRK: Orca. What an orca can do: great strength and mass, fast swimming, ultrasonic waves that briefly paralyze. Drying out saps him; heat, fire and long hours out of water are his limit.
personality: Responsible: Treats a drill as seriously as a live rescue and expects the same of his people.
Commanding: Lets his size and stillness hold a room, then directs it with a few precise orders.
Rigorous: A good showing earns a nod; a careless one, an exact correction.
Speaking style: Firm, resonant commands and controlled assessment; formal and unhurried.
abilities: Ultrasonic waves: Sound that briefly paralyzes those caught in it; its reach is limited.
Orca strength: Crushing strength and mass on land, more in water; heat and dehydration erode it fast.
Squad command: Directs sidekicks whose cement guns pin targets and seal exits; they cannot match his power.
Hero assessment: Reads a young hero's readiness and nerve in one encounter and gives an exact, unsparing verdict.
Fighting style: Advances behind cement fire, paralyzes a group with ultrasound, then closes with orca strength.
Gang Orca.visualDescription: A huge, powerfully built heteromorph man with the head of an orca: glossy black skin, white patches above the eyes, red eyes, a broad blunt snout with rows of pointed teeth and a dorsal fin rising behind his head. He wears a white suit over a high-collared fuchsia-pink shirt with a black tie. Stern, imposing, composed expression.
